reason: E2 directly supports that heterogeneous strain from lattice distortion enhances strength-ductility synergy, but it does not address dynamic loading conditions. E1 compares as-cast and deformed samples at high strain rates but attributes differences to micro bands and strain rate sensitivity, not lattice distortion, and does not control grain size. The key premise linking lattice distortion to dynamic strengthening is thus only partially supported.
premises: Severe lattice distortion in CrMnFeCoNi creates heterogeneous local strain fields
These strain fields act as primary barriers to dislocation motion under dynamic loading
This leads to enhanced dynamic yield strength and retained ductility
Homogenizing annealing reduces lattice distortion while keeping grain size similar
